Taste ok but cheating on bills
Oct 2019 • Friends
Seven of us went there to try .
Environment just so , food is acceptable, the waitress was well trained to convince us how to order.
Taste is Good and portion are acceptable.
However, they Will count More on the paper napkins, drinks and the waitress even told me that she has made mistakes and asked if I can pay 10% on the bill.
Since her Service was Great , we said yes but when I left I tended to believe that It was their strategy.
Anyway , worth a try but be careful of the bill.

Excellent rolls and delicious beef
Sep 2018 • Family
Great joint in D5 - a quirky part of HCMC a bit further away from the tourist bustle of D1.
Au Pagolac is a family run business passed down from one generation to another and so on. That really showed with the restaurant itself having a very homely feel to it, with excellent service throughout our visit.
The food was delicious. We had the deep fried rolls and some beef rolls wrapped in some kind of spinach leaf. Both were absolutely amazing.
Will come back soon. Thanks, all.
